solutionSql:
SELECT id, status
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
  AND status LIKE 'del%'
ORDER BY id;
ambiguities: The instructions say a prefix match can use an index, but status has no index in this schema and planRequirement is null, so no plan is graded. This did not change the answer.
notes: Unchanged SQL. Revised text says statuses are lowercase, so LIKE 'del%' is exact in case. 12 rows (ids 3 to 47, step 4), identical on all three datasets. The ticket states no column types, so columnsMatchTicket compares names only.
